newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-ANDERSON SCORES AS MONACO GO TWO POINTS CLEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ANDERSON SCORES AS MONACO GO TWO POINTS CLEAR.

text.p: Brazilian striker Anderson headed home seven minutes from time to give Monaco a 1-0 home win over Cannes and put them two points clear at the top of the French first division on Saturday.
UEFA Cup quarter-finalists Monaco pulled away from second placed Paris Saint-Germain. PSG were held 0-0 away by Nantes, who extended their record unbeaten run to 15 matches.
Monaco have 45 points and PSG 43, while Bastia retained third place on 39 with a 2-1 win at Lille with goals by forwards Franck Vandecasteele and Pierre Laurent.
Bordeaux, now on 37, climbed above champions Auxerre -- away to Marseille on Sunday -- to fourth after a 2-0 home win over Rennes. Striker Kaba Diawara and midfielder Marc Zanotti scored.
Metz joined Auxerre on 35 points with a 1-0 away win at Starsbourg. French international Robert Pires scored in the 16th minute.
